question: Spot the **correct spelling** of Aristotelian well-being.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Eudaimonia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **“Eudaimonia”** refers to the Aristotelian concept of well-being or flourishing, a central theme in his philosophy.
